NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 7 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, October 25 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 20, 11:53 PM ET

Jahmyr Gibbs is the top-projected running back on the Week 7 DraftKings main slate at 30.6 DraftKings points for $9,800, against Green Bay. Christian McCaffrey (23.4, $7,600) and Bijan Robinson (23.2, $8,500) are next.

Jahmyr Gibbs is also the top value at the position: 3.13 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 20, 11:53 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 7

Jahmyr Gibbs, DET vs GB ($9,800)

Jahmyr Gibbs carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 30.6 DraftKings points at $9,800, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 7.2 points clear of Christian McCaffrey. The model gives him 22.5 carries and 5.6 targets. The salary works out to 3.13 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Gibbs averaged 30.8 points with a simulated floor of 18.5 and a ceiling of 46.5, and he holds 29% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Detroit is a 3-point favorite at home against Green Bay, with an implied team total of 27.75 in a game totaled at 52.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF at ATL ($7,600)

Christian McCaffrey projects 2nd at the position with 23.4 DraftKings points at $7,600, 3rd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 14.2 carries and 6.7 targets. The salary works out to 3.08 projected points per $1,000, 2nd of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 23.6 points with a simulated floor of 11.5 and a ceiling of 39.6, and he holds 40% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 4.5-point favorite on the road against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 27.5 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs SF ($8,500)

Bijan Robinson projects 3rd at the position with 23.2 DraftKings points at $8,500, 4th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 17.0 carries and 4.8 targets. The salary works out to 2.73 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 19 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 23.1 points with a simulated floor of 11.3 and a ceiling of 39.7, and he holds 15% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 4.5-point underdog at home against San Francisco, with an implied team total of 23 in a game totaled at 50.5.

Value: Braelon Allen, NYJ vs MIA ($5,900)

Braelon Allen projects for 17.3 DraftKings points at $5,900, which works out to 2.93 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 19 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 19.4 carries and 2.3 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Allen averaged 17.1 points with a simulated floor of 7.2 and a ceiling of 31.2, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. The Jets are a 4.5-point favorite at home against Miami, with an implied team total of 21.5 in a game totaled at 38.5.
